import json, os, subprocess
for p in ['compressed_video.mp4','compression_report.json']:
    assert os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 0, p
orig=float(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_entries','format=duration','-of','default=nk=1:nw=1','data/input_video.mp4'], text=True).strip())
comp=float(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_entries','format=duration','-of','default=nk=1:nw=1','compressed_video.mp4'], text=True).strip())
streams=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_entries','stream=codec_type,codec_name','-of','json','compressed_video.mp4'], text=True))
assert any(s['codec_type']=='video' for s in streams['streams'])
assert any(s['codec_type']=='audio' for s in streams['streams'])
report=json.load(open('compression_report.json'))
assert abs(report['original_duration_seconds']-orig) < 0.01
assert abs(report['compressed_duration_seconds']-comp) < 0.01
assert abs(report['original_duration_seconds']-report['compressed_duration_seconds']-report['removed_duration_seconds']) < 0.01
seg_sum=0
last=-1
for seg in report['segments_removed']:
    assert 0 <= seg['start'] < seg['end'] <= report['original_duration_seconds'] + 0.01
    assert seg['start'] >= last - 1e-6
    assert abs((seg['end']-seg['start'])-seg['duration']) < 0.01
    last=seg['end']; seg_sum += seg['duration']
assert abs(report['removed_duration_seconds']-seg_sum) < 0.01
print('VALIDATION_OK')
